plan: Hold all accepted state in the public `session` dict with exactly the four contract keys, mutated in place only after an action fully validates (validate-then-commit).
Route `handle` through a per-type dispatch table of small handlers, one per action type, each returning a screen dict.

Build every screen through one `_screen` helper that enforces the invariant: choices are the appointment list (in input order, fresh copies) exactly when the prompt is `Choose appointment`, otherwise empty.

Derive the next-unmet-step prompt from session state in `_next_prompt` (contact not confirmed -> `Confirm contact`, no appointment -> `Choose appointment`, else `Review and complete`), reused for corrections and as the prompt on error screens.
Report invalid/malformed actions via `_error`, which returns a screen whose first message starts with `Error:` and performs no mutation, so accepted data is never corrupted and nothing raises.

Inject I/O as duck-typed `action_source`/`screen_sink` ports; `run_once` raises RuntimeError before touching either if one is missing, then reads one action, handles it, calls `display` exactly once, and returns the same screen object.
Defensively copy the appointments sequence at construction so later external mutation cannot affect emitted choices.
mechanisms: authoritative session dictionary with validate-then-commit mutation
single screen builder enforcing the choices/prompt invariant
non-mutating Error: screens for invalid or malformed actions
constructor-injected duck-typed input/output ports with RuntimeError guard in run_once
defensive copying of appointments and per-screen choice lists
